title: Concept: Contract self-destruct via selfdestruct (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, selfdestruct destroys the contract and sends its balance away. An unguarded path lets any caller erase the deployed code and funds. The remedy is an owner-only, reviewed migration path.
applicability: solidity contracts with lifecycle functions; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Loss of contract state and funds through an unguarded destroy; HIGH severity.
